description: MAP-24 vectors: histories that hold parts with nothing for the wire they are sent to (hidden thinking carrying another dialect's state, empty text, a citation that quotes nothing, an empty system prompt) and the parts that must still be written (state the dialect consumes, tool results). The harness's mapping direction builds each vector's `request` with build_request for each provider in the vector's `providers` (default: `dialects`), the model filled in from `models`. `same_as`: the wire request must equal, whole, the one built from `same_as.request` (for `same_as.providers`, default every provider of the vector). `expect`: for that provider, each named key of the built body must equal the value given. Every built body must hold no text block with no characters and no message with nothing in it. Generated by tools/make_empty_parts_vectors.py; do not edit by hand.

provenance.evidence: docs/mapping-rules.md MAP-24 (rules 1 to 4) and MAP-7 rules 8, 9 and 11; spec/invariants.md INV-014; changes/2026-11-11-empty-parts.md. The `expect` blocks are written by hand in each dialect's spelling as the cases pin it (cases/anthropic/foreign_reasoning_history.json, cases/vertex/foreign_reasoning_history.json, cases/deepseek/foreign_reasoning_history.json, cases/openai/reasoning_replay.json); the provider facts behind the rule are the receipts under receipts/2026-11-11-empty-parts/.

build.why: The report (issue #3): hidden reasoning from an OpenAI Responses model, before a tool call and before text, in a history sent to another dialect. Rule 2: state for another dialect is not state here; rule 1: with no text either, the part writes nothing. On its own dialect the item goes back natively (MAP-7 rule 8), `summary` present and empty.

build.why: The edge of the rule: a data part is never a part with nothing. An assistant data part (a judged or structured answer kept in the history) is written on every wire as its value in compact canonical JSON (changes/2026-09-19-jev-state.md D3: "An assistant data part ... renders the same way"), so its message is written. Found by the history replay: three SDKs dropped it on the Responses and Chat Completions wires and one refused it.
